name: Mesa de jantar
prompt: Create ONE isolated original medieval fantasy VTT furniture sprite. STRICT CAMERA: a true orthographic plan viewed vertically DOWN at 90 degrees, with ZERO tilt. Show ONLY horizontal surfaces visible from directly overhead. The object stands in its normal use orientation, north/back toward image top. No visible vertical fronts, backrest elevations, cabinet doors, drawer fronts, side faces, feet or standing legs. Rectangular surfaces have perfectly parallel opposite edges; circular tops are true circles, never ellipses. STYLE: finely hand-painted tactical battlemap like the supplied references, crisp delicate dark contours, warm worn oak and iron, natural grain and subtle small scratches, restrained earthy palette, a tiny soft contact shadow only. Rich readable crafted details, no glossy product photography and no heavy 3D render. Draw the complete SINGLE asset centered on genuinely transparent alpha with a narrow clear margin; no room, floor patch, people, grid, labels, text, watermark or extra furniture. Reference images are visual/style guidance only; do not copy their whole room, exact arrangement or branding. Subject: ONE large long rustic oak dining TABLE by itself. View only its rectangular tabletop, made from five broad joined planks with beautiful knots, small worn edges and tiny iron fastener caps. Its long axis runs left-right, footprint ratio 2:1. No visible apron, side wall or legs. Do NOT include any chairs, benches, plates, food, rug or place settings; those are separate placeable assets. It should be an exquisite bare wooden tabletop.
